relationships.evidence_quote: TMZ mitigated tactile allodynia, thermal hypoalgesia, numbness and fine motor discoordination associated with PTX in Swiss mice.

key_findings: Trimetazidine mitigates paclitaxel-induced neuropathy via inhibition of TLR4/p38 signaling, lower MMP9 and IL-1β, preserved IL-10.
Paclitaxel reduces neuronal klotho, rescued by TMZ, without affecting antitumor activity.
